meaning: (Hiphil) to constrain, press, bring into straits, straiten, oppress

elsewhere.note: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress…
She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to…
For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress…
